verdict.reasons: Candidate displays a single upright white and blue AFP drip-tape carton roll matching the approved reference identity. The 'AFP' text and 'Drip Irrigation Tape' sleeve caption are readable and consistent with authorized branding. The Persian script appears integrated into the physical curvature of the carton without visible pasted-on artifacts or counterfeit alterations. The scene contains appropriate irrigation evidence with thin laterals and neutral seedlings; the required watermark is visible. There are no core defects, mixed product families, impossible geometry, or people present.

focused_physical_review.reason: In the right detail view, a black irrigation line emerges directly from behind the package base on the same axis, establishing line_touches_or_crosses_package=true. The soil gap behind the package is not broad or uninterrupted due to the line crossing the footprint. The left detail view shows a distinct, thin white protruding strip/tail emerging horizontally from the lower front of the white carton body.
